source.stem:
A car travels 6.0 km along a main road in 6.0 minutes. It then travels 2.0 km along a minor road in 6.0 minutes.
Which calculation of average speed for the whole journey is correct?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The roof lifts even when the pressure below equals the low pressure above.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The balloons move apart because the fast air between them has higher pressure.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Blowing between the balloons lowers the pressure equally between them and throughout the surrounding still air.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Even with still air, the pressure above the roof is lower simply because it is above.

intelligence.enrichment: High-speed air is accompanied by lower pressure; higher pressure on nearby or opposite sides pushes objects toward the low-pressure region. Fast air between balloons lowers pressure between them so outside air pressure pushes them together; fast wind over a roof lowers pressure above it so higher pressure below can lift it. The learner predicts lower pressure where air moves faster and uses the resulting pressure imbalance to explain motion or roof lift. Faster wind always means stronger pressure in the place where the wind is moving fastest.
